title: Scientific Conclave & Interactive Session on Indian Pharmacopoeia 2026
bodyHtml:
The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), Ghaziabad, in collaboration with the National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER), Guwahati, is pleased to announce a Scientific Conclave & Interactive Session on Indian Pharmacopoeia 2026.

Theme:

"Advancing Quality, Safety, and Innovation in Drugs and Phytopharmaceuticals"

📅 Date: 27 August 2026 (Thursday)
🕘 Time: 09:00 AM – 05:00 PM
📍 Venue: Mini Conference Hall, NIPER, Guwahati
Registration Fee: ₹1,000/- (excluding 18% GST)

The conclave will bring together experts from regulatory authorities, academia, research institutions, and the pharmaceutical industry to discuss the latest developments in the Indian Pharmacopoeia 2026, regulatory compliance, quality assurance, elemental impurities, IP Reference Substances (IPRS), and phytopharmaceuticals."
Register by scanning the QR code in the flyer.
